profile.headline: Frontend Developer at Crate & Barrel
profile.summary: Front-End Developer with proven experience at 360Connect and AWGE in helping companies create and maintain web applications with a focus on efficient code, creative design, and responsiveness across devices. Capable of continuously learning and keeping up to date with the latest in frontend technology outside of work. Passionate about pushing the boundaries of modern UX/UI design with efficient, web performant code. I love turning people’s website ideas into a reality, and I hope my work reflects this!

positions.title: Web Developer/Designer
positions.description:
- Developed custom WordPress themes and plugins for use with both headless and traditional CMS installations using PHP, JS, JQuery, SCSS and MySQL.
- Maintained an affiliate embedded quote form widget component using PHP
- Implemented A/B experiments to optimize user experience and conversion rates
- Launched and managed 5+ landing pages that use a RESTful Lead Management System API
- Worked in an Agile development environment, contributing to daily stand-ups and sprint planning

positions.title: Frontend Developer
positions.description:
- Designed user interfaces and websites for a creative agency found by A$AP Rocky
- Translated user requirements by creating wireframes with Figma
- Created 10+ ReactJS SPAs for multiple clients that are responsive, accessible, and performant across all devices
- Developed data visualization components with AWS using Node.js

positions.title: Tutor
positions.description:
- Assisted students in all levels of computer science with the basics of object oriented programming
- Instructed college level students in the fundamentals of web development

projects.title: Austin Mahone
projects.description:
- Created a NextJS website for Austin Mahone, an American singer/songwriter with over 11 million Instagram followers and 3.5 million monthly Spotify listeners
- Used blender to design 3D renders and graphics
- Integrated the Instagram Basic Display API to pull images from Instagram to display on the site

projects.title: Trippy Triangle
projects.description:
- Worked with 3D engine Blender and WebGL/Three.js code to create custom models
- Used React Three Fiber to render a Three.js scene
- Developed an interesting animation using algebraic expressions
